evidence:
Authority: opened the actual frozen rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx with openpyxl. Quality Checks row 6 (A6=5, C6=instruction_leaks_no_grader_machinery) requires: 'The prompt never names the judge, rubric, dimensions, weights, test paths, or grader sentinels.' Internal Quality Checks row 6 repeats that requirement without an additional annotation. Deterministic Checks row 14, check-instruction-hygiene.py, includes all /instructions notes, IDs, sentinels, placeholders and long criterion-text overlaps; row 13 identifies the separate finished-prompt check. Applied frozen harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/SKILL.md, references/quality-checks.md:25-27, references/deterministic-checks.md:58 and the staged contract. Current qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md was read; its independent-credit and missing-runtime corrections do not turn this textual leakage check into an app-score measurement.

Scope: manually read the complete frozen task/instruction.md and all six environment/instructions/*.md files (behaviour, integration, overview, policy, security and ui), plus environment/assets/seed_data.json and environment/Dockerfile. instruction.md:5 directs the builder to the six notes and seed; :9 identifies /app and /instructions/integration.md, not grading paths. integration.md:5 publicly states the necessary node /app/server.js command, 0.0.0.0:3000 listener, /app/public/index.html and /api/health; :7 states DB_PATH and database persistence. These are product/runtime requirements, not leaked tests. environment/Dockerfile:14-15 copies only instructions/ and assets/ into the builder image, with no tests or solution copy; the complete environment inventory consists of that Dockerfile, six notes and one seed file. seed_data.json:3-4 contains an empty snippets list and a product-facing description, not probes.

Executed source checks: scripts/check_public_criterion_ids.py on the frozen task exited 0, scanned all 73 criterion IDs against all seven public Markdown files, and reported colliding_ids=[] and passed=true. scripts/check_public_grader_terms.py exited 0 with seven files, matches=[] and passed=true. These are local regression checks, not the unavailable private platform checker. A separate case-insensitive scan for the skill's complete pattern judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score\.py|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel across the brief, all six notes and seed returned no matches. Parsed all five judge.toml files: constraints 1, render 1, functional 58, polish 7 and visual 6 criteria. No criterion IDs appeared in public text. Also read all eleven private comparison files (five judge TOMLs, five prompts and app_context.md) computationally and checked 208 distinctive hyphenated/underscored literals and additional probe/title/placeholder strings against every one of the nine builder-facing files; matches=[]. This includes private literals CW gate , QC Title Sibling, async-error-marker, promise-error-marker, cw-qc-network.invalid, {app_context} and {criteria}. Their private locations include tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:25, tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:37, :287, :298 and :387; none is exposed in the brief, notes or seed.

Overlap assessment: compared tokenized text from every public brief/note/seed file with every one of the 73 criterion descriptions. The longest contiguous overlap was six words, 'copy of the last successful document', between environment/instructions/behaviour.md:5 and tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:57. This is the requested CSS behavior, and it exposes no criterion identifier, weight, test sequence or probe. The brief itself has only three-word maximum criterion overlap. The longest overlap with the full private prompts/context is the ten-word control-purpose list 'title and filename fields run stop auto run clear console' in environment/instructions/ui.md:7 and tests/scored/polish/prompt.md:43; these ordinary public controls are independently required product features, not grader machinery.

Counterexample attempts: considered a conforming interface using different control labels and API routes. environment/instructions/policy.md:5 explicitly permits 'layout, control labels, indentation width, API routes and request fields'; its freedom is not curtailed by public criterion names or sentinels. Considered a broken playground which only recognizes a supplied fixed test marker or title. No such private marker/title is supplied to the builder; tests/gates/render/judge.toml:25 instead selects a new marker, requires actual Run output in preview and console, and says a hardcoded sample is insufficient. This reasoning identifies no false-fail or false-pass caused by public leakage; it is not an empirical claim about the overall grader.

Binding and limits: independently SHA256-checked every frozen manifest task/rules entry and current engine input, 91 files total, with zero mismatches against qc/runs/coldwater-2026-09-30-hardening/manifest.json. Source inspection and local read-only scans confirm this row. No Docker, app judge, Oracle, target-model, paid or network run was performed or inferred. Golden browser logs are not required to decide whether these frozen public files contain grader machinery; this report establishes no runtime or overall QC clearance.
